same_numerical_config_original_compariso.scope: Same-video original FicTrac comparison; neither output is physical ground truth. Agreement, acceptance and low image error do not establish motion accuracy.

alignment.method: reference_frame = candidate_frame + explicit offset; no automatic lag selection
alignment.clock_note: Frame identity is asserted by the same-video replay provenance, not inferred from wall-clock timestamps. All reference-clock mismatches, including initial or terminal clock switches, are retained explicitly. Shared video intervals drive derivatives.

gaps.semantics: Frozen all-frame deltas/paths are missing measurements. Relocalization publishes no hidden motion. Original .dat has no validity flag.

trajectory_all_common_rows.alignment: Only initial position and heading; no later fitting, scaling or gap reconstruction.

rolling_comparison.note: Every available overlapping window includes all candidate decisions, including frozen missing-motion rows.

motion_structure.clock: Both derivatives use the validated candidate video presentation intervals. Candidate excludes every unmeasured delta; acceleration never spans a missing interval.

comparison.quality_format_difference: Native records frame,timestamp_ms,accepted,status,fit_error using full float serialization. Headless adds samples and prints timestamp/error to6/9 decimals. Byte/string equality is consequently not expected. Numerical/acceptance evidence compared at headless output precision.

visual_verification.reason: Canonical config deliberately has do_display:n. Actual X11 pixels show the do_display=n tracking-continues banner; view toggles do not override the configuration. No broad rendered-image validation claim.
visual_verification.computed_observation: Final green sphere outline follows the visible silhouette. Thresholded ROI retains strong black/white pattern, warped differences are mainly thin edges, and accumulated atlas retains distinct pattern boundaries with some stippled/gray partially learned cells. No physical ground-truth accuracy claim.

native_full.harness_initial_failure: Initial direct quality-dictionary equality treated different output schemas/float formatting as failure; retained verbatim in initial-comparison-report.json. No tracking replay repeated for corrected semantic comparison.
native_full.scope: Full unpaced 3565-frame numerical replay, numeric-only recording; actual image display suppressed in this headless config, independently checked with final visible config below.
native_full.timing_claim: Descriptive native decode/track/UI/recording wall interval, not isolated performance or real-time 100FPS evidence.

visual_inspection.normal: Visible full source image with green fitted rim following the ball silhouette, native toolbar/status and path inset. Identity-axis overlay is visible; physical lab orientation remains unverified.
visual_inspection.diagnostics: Visible six-panel native mosaic: strong thresholded pattern, sparse warped-difference residuals during the initial stationary interval, instant/accumulated atlas containing only the visible initial surface and explicitly gray unknown regions.
visual_inspection.scope: 50initial frames only; full-motion tracking numerical evidence retained independently in native-final. No physical ground-truth or throughput claim.

required_checks.resolved_build_prerequisite: Initial Clippy lacked libclang discovery; final run used existing LIBCLANG_PATH, no dependency/source workaround.

serial_timing_boundary: Cases ran serially after native/build/test activity completed. CLI summary wall starts before input/config/decode and includes tracking, numeric/quality/SVG/map I/O; ends before summary/rename completion. External time includes entire process. Synthetic generation is outside internal tracking wall but inside external command time. VR3 harness wall also includes fresh suffix generation/replay and analysis; actual VR3 CLI time retained separately. All are this fixture/machine, no speedup claim.
